seo.description: Tidepool: a tiny notes app that opens instantly, works offline and keeps your notes as plain files. Free and open source.

props.title: Notes that open before you finish the thought
props.text: Tidepool is a tiny notes app. It starts in under a second, works with no connection and keeps every note as a plain text file you own.
props.aside:
$ brew install tidepool
$ tidepool new "shopping list"

Windows and Linux builds are on the releases page.

items.title: Opens in a blink
items.text: No account, no loading screen, no sync spinner. Press the shortcut and type.

items.title: Plain files
items.text: Every note is a .txt file in a folder you choose. Back it up, grep it, move it.

items.title: Works offline
items.text: On a plane, on a train, in the basement. Nothing in it needs the network.

items.title: Small
items.text: 4 MB to download. It will not ask to update itself every week.

items.title: Download it
items.text: Pick your computer on the releases page, or use the one-line install above.

items.title: Open it
items.text: No setup. A notes folder is made for you in Documents.

items.title: Write
items.text: Press N for a new note, / to search every note.

items.title: Version 1.0
items.text: Search across every note, and a dark mode.

items.title: Version 0.8
items.text: Notes folders on a USB stick or a shared drive.

props.title: Help make it better
props.text: Found a bug or have an idea? Open an issue, or send a fix. First-timers are welcome.
